description: Gnomonkit supply-chain: suggests patch-review when a dependency version is about to move (suggest only, never blocks)

hooks.command: case "$OSTYPE" in msys*|cygwin*) py=python;; *) command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && py=python3 || py=python;; esac; exec "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/skill_router.py"
